newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates mostly lower.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were lower in most maturities, reflecting the movement in money market rates, traders said on Wednesday.
Only the two-week rate was steady, and the one year rate was slightly up.
"Banks are adjusting their rates," said a dealer, in line with the softer rates in the money market.
But some banks are trying to swap their dollars in exchange for pesos in the short term so they could have enough money in case of some tightening due to Christmas spending, the same dealer said.
